question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

The lion's share

options.text: The most challenging goal of many
The biggest and best part of a whole

solution:
The correct answer is **'The biggest and best part of a whole'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'The lion's share' **is** 'The biggest and best part of a whole'.**
 
• **The lion's share: **the largest part of something. (किसी चीज का सबसे बड़ा भाग)
 
 
• *Example: William was appointed editor, which meant that he did **the lion's share **of the work.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *The biggest and best part of a whole.*
